title: DarkMusic 1.5.21 (Beta)
changelog:
• Beta Release: Smooth Train Pull scroll lyrics animation across all visible lines (from top to bottom) with elastic spring cascade.
• Particle Dissolve Animation: Controls dissolve into drifting micro-particles when mini lyrics expands into fullscreen lyrics view.
• Pure AMOLED Black Theme across all screens and components.
• Top Ended Lyric Peek: 50% bottom preview anchored at top edge.
• Matched Line Spacing: Active and inactive lyrics line-height matched.
• Silent Update: Available on-demand when checked manually in Settings > About.
releaseNotes: v1.5.21 (Beta): Train Pull scroll lyrics animation across all visible lines, Particle Dissolve mini-to-fullscreen lyrics transition, pure AMOLED theme, and silent on-demand updates.
